noveltyJustification: Nine findings are new per-package verdicts and two extend the plugin-market and base-mount evidence into a no-migration conclusion.
answeredQuestions: For each third-party Pi plugin, does the harness ship the capability natively, offer a market equivalent, or is it irrelevant to dispatch?
ruledOut: Porting any Pi package as a dsh plugin
Installing from the plugin market as a migration shortcut

label: Six of the ten Pi packages have a native equivalent already mounted by dsh-base: todo_write, the user-questions seam, compaction with result pruning and image offload, subagents plus the team task board, plan mode, and web_fetch/web_search.
rpiv-ask-user-question maps to the native user-questions seam, but a headless dispatch has no live answer channel, so the verdict is drop for dispatch and keep for interactive profiles.
rpiv-todo is natively replaced by todo_write, which persists across turns and reopened sessions with whole-list replacement and per-session ownership.
pi-blackhole's compaction half maps to compaction-basic plus the tool-result pruner and image offload; its observational-memory half has no native store and is dropped.
pi-btw's parallel side conversations map to subagent/subagent_fork and the team task board, which share the checkout and keep intermediate traffic out of the parent conversation.
pi-cache-optimizer is replaced by route configuration: cacheControlFormat, supportsLongCacheRetention and profile headers cover prompt-cache markers and session affinity, with no plugin needed.

pi-fast-mode has no native equivalent: the config catalog exposes no serviceTier or service_tier field on a model route, and the harness executor's serviceTier is an OpenCode-runner concept, so the verdict is not portable.
pi-plan-build maps to native plan mode for interactive profiles, but exit_plan_mode fails closed without an interactive review, so headless dispatches use a prompt-phase pattern instead.
pi-claude-code-ui and pi-statusline are rendering-only packages with no headless surface, so they are not relevant to dispatch.

pi-web-access is partly replaced: web_fetch and web_search are native and the headless profile routes DeepSeek Search and Fetch through the model credential, while PDF extraction, YouTube and local-video analysis have no native equivalent.

The plugin market is not a Pi compatibility layer: dsh ships no index source, indexes list installable dsh bundles, and Pi packages are not dsh bundles, so the market matters only as a future distribution channel for the repo's own bundle.

direction: Porting any Pi package as a dsh plugin
reason: None is a dsh bundle and six capabilities already exist natively.
